title: Pullman's 18th Street flank gets its broad ivy-hung windows
items: 1729 Prairie's 18th Street face, east of the carriage porch, now has the two broad square-headed windows under transoms that the c. 1900 Detroit photograph shows, in place of narrow round-headed lights.
Ivy now clothes that stretch of wall and the carriage porch's east piers, kept clear of the windows as the house's other ivy is.
